# WoW AndroWhere 0.5.1

- **CurseForge uses your own key or proxy.** The app no longer sends CurseForge searches through the WoW Foreverywhere project's server. To use CurseForge, open Settings → CurseForge and enter your own CurseForge API key, which is stored encrypted on the device and only sent to CurseForge, or the address of a proxy you run. Without either, CurseForge is off and Addons says so. Wago, WoWInterface and the GitHub catalog work as before.

## Install

Download **WoW-AndroWhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 0.4.1, 0.5.0 or any earlier test build and keeps your settings, saved login, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
